easy_fields.description: XTREME-S is a new benchmark designed to evaluate universal cross-lingual speech representations across 102 languages from 10+ language families, 3 different domains, and 4 task families: speech recognition, classification, speech-to-text translation, and retrieval. It aims to simplify multilingual speech representation evaluation and catalyze research in universal speech representation learning. The benchmark includes a new general-purpose massively multilingual evaluation dataset dubbed Fleurs.
